description:

Not my best rendition - a few timing issues,(maar nou ja...) but enjoy the effort of added chords with lyrics. Earphones on full volume might be helpful as the upload seems 'soft' for some reason

I wouldn't have a clue what this song is about but the visual poetry of the lyrics and quirky character names makes it interesting. I enjoy playing it from time to time. If you DO know what this song is about, feel free to share it with us as there's not a lot on the web about it. Thanks for watching and hope you enjoyed.
